tools.name: get_program_terms
tools.description: SBA Express program rules: maximum loan, SBA guaranty, rate caps by loan size, line of credit rules, FY2027 guaranty fees and exceptions, with sources.

tools.name: get_max_rates_today
tools.description: Today's maximum variable interest rate for SBA Express (and 7(a)) loans by loan size: live WSJ Prime plus SBA's capped spread. Optionally pass an amount to get the cap for that loan.

tools.name: estimate_guaranty_fee
tools.description: SBA upfront guaranty fee for an SBA Express or standard 7(a) loan under the FY2027 schedule, with exceptions.

tools.name: estimate_payment
tools.description: Level monthly payment and total interest for a fully amortizing loan. Also returns today's SBA Express rate cap for the amount.

tools.name: get_program_statistics
tools.description: SBA Express loans by fiscal year, loan sizes, borrower types, industries, rates at approval and charge-offs, from SBA's loan-level file.

tools.name: list_lenders
tools.description: Lenders ranked by number of SBA Express loans in the most recent fiscal years. Pass a state to get the most active lenders there.

tools.name: get_lender
tools.description: A lender's SBA Express lending record: loan count, sizes, line of credit share, top states. Matches on lender name.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: SBA Express loan count, dollars, median loan, top lenders and top industries for one state.

tools.name: get_financing_link
tools.description: Link where a small business owner can request SBA Express financing options; the request is routed to lending partners. Free, no obligation.
